result.brief: 提出免训练稀疏注意力方法PARK，通过保留原始查询并基于当前查询变换键进行聚类，修正块检索中的查询聚合与键聚类度量偏差，配合融合GPU内核，在HunyuanVideo与Wan上提升检索精度并加速视频生成推理。
result.reason: Training-free sparse attention for video DiTs improving block retrieval accuracy and inference efficiency, directly serving video generation efficiency and representation.
